subject.title: Feature Request: Add premium request % to /usage footer

question: Should active-provider quota windows become part of the built-in per-response footer, and if so should they appear only in `/usage full` or also in `/usage tokens`?
rationale: Current behavior deliberately keeps provider quotas in status and provider-usage surfaces while defining token and full footers separately; code inspection cannot decide the desired default visibility, polling cadence, or acceptable reply-path cost.

options.title: Add to full mode
options.body: Expose cached active-provider quota windows in `/usage full` only, preserving `/usage tokens` as the lightweight token/cache/cost mode.

options.title: Add to both modes
options.body: Append quota windows to both token and full modes for maximum per-response visibility at the cost of a less distinct lightweight mode.

options.title: Keep status-only
options.body: Keep provider quotas in `/status`, CLI, Control UI, and app surfaces and close this footer request as intentionally out of scope.

recommendation.title: Add to full mode
recommendation.body: Expose cached active-provider quota windows in `/usage full` only, preserving `/usage tokens` as the lightweight token/cache/cost mode.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest history across provider-usage loading, formatting, status presentation, and the prior product-boundary review for this issue.
